newsitem.title: DUBAI: ARY Traders firm to resume gold exports to Pakistan.
newsitem.headline: ARY Traders firm to resume gold exports to Pakistan.

text.p: Dubai-based ARY Traders said on Thursday it would resume gold and silver imports into Pakistan on Saturday after receiving assurances from Islamabad that its licence was still valid.
"God willing, we will start on Saturday," ARY chief executive and managing director Abdul Razzak told Reuters.

ARY, which since January 1995 has held the only licence to import gold and silver into Pakistan, had suspended shipments on December 22 amid media reports in Pakistan which raised speculation about the licence's validity.

The United Arab Emirates English-language Khaleej Times newspaper had said the confusion resulted from news reports of an alleged close association between ARY and the previous Pakistani government, which was dismissed in November.
ARY has now received a letter from the commerce ministry confirming the validity of the licence, Razzak said.
But he added that ARY would no longer be the sole licence-holders, as licences had been issued recently to two other traders.
"They issued two more licences about a week or 10 days ago," Razzak said, adding that these went to a trader in Jeddah and another in Karachi.
Dubai is a major gold trading centre.
